generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client"
  output   = "../generated/prisma"
}

generator sqlmodel {
  provider            = "prisma-sqlmodel-gen"
  output              = "../../reporter/db/generated"
  moduleName          = "models.py"
  emitInit            = "true"
  strict              = "true"
  headerComment       = "true"
  sqlmodelImportStyle = "sqlmodel"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
}

model Article {
  id         String    @id @default(dbgenerated("gen_random_uuid()")) @db.Uuid
  createdAt  DateTime  @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt  DateTime  @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  deletedAt  DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  companyId  BigInt    @map("company_id")
  filingId   BigInt    @map("filing_id")
  title      String
  content    Json
  fullPrompt Json      @map("fullPrompt")
  authors    Json
  editors    Json
  old_id     BigInt?
  company    Company   @relation(fields: [companyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)
  filing     Filing    @relation(fields: [filingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([authors], map: "pgarticle_authors", type: Gin)
  @@index([companyId], map: "pgarticle_company_id")
  @@index([companyId, createdAt(sort: Desc)], map: "pgarticle_company_created_at_desc")
  @@index([content], map: "pgarticle_content", type: Gin)
  @@index([createdAt(sort: Desc)], map: "pgarticle_created_at_desc")
  @@index([editors], map: "pgarticle_editors", type: Gin)
  @@index([filingId], map: "pgarticle_filing_id")
  @@index([fullPrompt], map: "pgarticle_fullPrompt", type: Gin)
  @@index([old_id], map: "pgarticle_old_id")
  @@map("article")
}

model Company {
  id              BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt       DateTime  @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt       DateTime  @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  deletedAt       DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  ticker          String?   @unique(map: "pgcompany_ticker") @db.VarChar(255)
  name            String    @db.VarChar(255)
  website         String?   @db.VarChar(255)
  isin            String    @unique(map: "pgcompany_isin") @db.VarChar(255)
  lei             String?   @unique(map: "pgcompany_lei") @db.VarChar(255)
  ric             String?   @unique(map: "pgcompany_ric") @db.VarChar(255)
  primaryExchange String?   @map("primary_exchange") @db.VarChar(255)
  country         String?   @db.VarChar(255)
  currency        String?   @db.VarChar(255)
  functionData    Json?     @map("function")
  prompt          String?
  articles        Article[]
  filings         Filing[]

  @@index([functionData], map: "pgcompany_function", type: Gin)
  @@map("company")
}

model Filing {
  id         BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt  DateTime  @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt  DateTime  @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  deletedAt  DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  companyId  BigInt    @map("company_id")
  title      String    @db.VarChar(255)
  fileHash   String?   @map("filehash")
  data       Json
  filingDate DateTime  @map("filing_date") @db.Date
  sourceUrl  String    @unique(map: "pgfiling_source_url") @map("source_url")
  status     String    @db.VarChar(255)
  old_id     BigInt?
  articles   Article[]
  chunks     FilingChunk[]
  company    Company   @relation(fields: [companyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([companyId], map: "pgfiling_company_id")
  @@index([companyId, filingDate(sort: Desc), id(sort: Desc)], map: "pgfiling_company_filing_date_id_desc")
  @@index([data], map: "pgfiling_data", type: Gin)
  @@map("filing")
}

model FilingChunk {
  id         BigInt    @id @default(autoincrement())
  createdAt  DateTime  @map("created_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  updatedAt  DateTime  @map("updated_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  deletedAt  DateTime? @map("deleted_at") @db.Timestamp(6)
  filingId   BigInt    @map("filing_id")
  ordinal    Int
  kind       String    @db.VarChar(32)
  text       String
  searchText String    @map("search_text")
  tokenCount Int       @map("token_count")
  startIndex Int?      @map("start_index")
  endIndex   Int?      @map("end_index")
  chunkHash  String    @unique(map: "pgfilingchunk_chunk_hash") @map("chunk_hash") @db.VarChar(64)
  data       Json?
  filing     Filing    @relation(fields: [filingId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade, onUpdate: NoAction)

  @@index([filingId], map: "pgfilingchunk_filing_id")
  @@unique([filingId, kind, ordinal], map: "pgfilingchunk_filing_kind_ordinal")
  @@map("filing_chunk")
}
